info.title: Exoplanet Finder API
info.description: AI-powered classification of NASA Kepler transit-like signals. Planet-like predictions are research leads, not confirmed discoveries.

post.description:
BLS on the flattened light curve of a catalogue star or a parsed upload. All values are
``measured``. Several seconds for a full 4-year Kepler light curve (results are cached).

Trapezoid fit, odd/even, secondary eclipse, individual transits, SNR, quality, folded/binned
curve with the model, a catalogue-vs-measured-vs-estimate comparison and derived estimates.

post.summary: Injection–recovery test on a real light curve (synthetic)
post.description:
Injects a SYNTHETIC trapezoid transit into a copy of a real cached Kepler light curve and runs
a blind BLS search. The response is flagged ``synthetic: true``; nothing is stored.

Downloads fresh snapshots from the NASA Exoplanet Archive and re-ingests the catalogue as a
``catalog_refresh`` job. If NASA is unreachable the job fails with a ``[nasa_unavailable]`` error.

post.description:
Creates the dataset (status ``building``) and starts a ``build_dataset`` job that downloads
missing light curves, processes every signal, records exclusions, splits by star and writes the
arrays. The new dataset id is in ``params.dataset_id`` of the returned job.

explanations), quality grades and issues, period/depth histograms per class, processing timings.

post.summary: Evaluate a model on its validation or test split (background job)
post.description:
Test-set evaluations are logged and numbered (see ``test_evaluation_number``); their metrics are
copied onto the model version. Iterate on the validation split.

schema.title: Response List Evaluations Api Evaluation Get

get.description:
Aligned metric table with confidence intervals; ``warnings`` and ``comparable=false`` when the
evaluations use different datasets or splits.

Metrics (at the validation-chosen threshold and at 0.5), 95 % bootstrap CIs, ROC/PR/reliability
curves, confusion matrix and inference timing.

Most confident first (highest score for predicted planet-like, lowest for predicted
false-positive-like), with catalogue info and the local view.

Drop in PR-AUC when shuffling the global view, the local view or each physical feature on the
evaluated split (logistic regression / random forest).

schema.title: Response List Jobs Api Jobs Get

get.summary: SSE stream of all job updates (job tray)
get.description:
First event ``snapshot`` = ``{jobs: JobOut[]}`` of queued/running jobs, then every
``progress``/``log``/``epoch``/``done`` event of every job (each with ``job_id``).

get.summary: Job detail with the last 200 log lines

post.description:
The job stops at its next checkpoint (between signals, mini-batches or downloads) and ends as
``cancelled``; partial artefacts are removed.

get.description:
First event ``snapshot`` = JobOut, then ``progress``/``log``/``epoch`` events, and ``done``
(after which the stream closes). For a finished job: ``snapshot`` + ``done``.

get.summary: Processed light curve of a catalogue star
get.description:
Stages raw/normalized/trend/flat (downsampled for display), segments, cleaning report and,
when an ephemeris is known (``signal_id`` or ``period``+``epoch``+``duration_hours``), the
predicted transit times and the folded + binned light curve.
Newest first, with validation metrics, latest test metrics, active flag and dataset name.

schema.title: Response List Models Api Models Get

get.summary: Model detail with model card and configuration

delete.summary: Delete a model version and its checkpoint
delete.description:
Removes the checkpoint directory, the model's evaluations and the predictions made with it. If
it was active, the most recent remaining model becomes active.

post.summary: Score one signal with one or more models
post.description:
Builds the views (catalogue, BLS or manual ephemeris), runs each model and stores one
prediction per model, including ``seen_in_split`` and warnings. Catalogue stars that are not
downloaded yet are downloaded synchronously unless ``download_if_missing`` is false.

get.description:
Latest catalogue-ephemeris score per signal per model, with agreement across models,
uncertainty and quality grade. These are leads for follow-up, not discoveries.

get.summary: Model cards of the four model types

schema.title: Response Model Types Api Training Model Types Get

get.description:
Times a few real training steps of a throw-away network on the dataset's examples (takes a few
seconds for CNNs). Baselines have no epochs (``seconds_per_epoch`` is null).

post.description:
Creates an experiment and a ``train`` job. Progress events include ``epoch`` records
(train/val loss, val PR-AUC/ROC-AUC/accuracy). The first successful model becomes active if no
model is active.

post.summary: Train all four model types sequentially (one job)
post.description:
One experiment per model type (logistic regression, random forest, single-view CNN, two-view
CNN) on the same dataset and splits, trained one after the other in a ``train_suite`` job.

Store the file and describe it: FITS header facts, or the CSV columns, a suggested column
mapping and preview rows to confirm before parsing.

post.summary: Parse an upload with a confirmed column mapping and time system
post.description:
BJD times are converted to BKJD (BJD - 2454833.0). The response lists warnings, e.g. that
non-Kepler-long-cadence data is out of distribution for the models.
